prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of an open cream-paper journal resting on a warm wooden desk, soft morning window light from the upper left casting a gentle diagonal shadow across the right page. The journal is A5 proportions, both pages visible, with a slight binding curve in the middle where the pages do not lie perfectly flat. The palette is muted — oat cream paper, ballpoint navy ink, terracotta washi tape, sage green pressed leaf, faded ochre ticket stub.

Subject:
A handmade scrapbook journal spread on a single calm Sunday. The left page shows three small instant-film style photographs attached by small corner tabs — not glued — each at a slightly different angle, plus a pasted ticket stub at the bottom. The right page is mostly handwriting in uneven ballpoint cursive that gently slopes downward line by line, a small doodled arrow, a pressed maple leaf taped with one strip of terracotta washi tape that has a visible air bubble, and a round coffee ring in the lower right corner.

Important details:
This image is the reference foundation for a four-image series. The handwriting cadence must be clearly personal: letters lean right, the lowercase 'g' has a looped descender, spacing between words is inconsistent. The washi tape edges are scissor-cut with tiny fibre frays. The photos have slightly yellowed borders. The coffee ring is perfectly circular only on the inside; the outside is broken. Paper texture is visible — fine grain, one small fingerprint smudge near the binding. The color palette stays soft earth-tones. Leave obvious empty cream paper space so the viewer feels this is the beginning of the week.

Use case:
Reference image 1 of 4 for the One Journal · A Week series. Later images will preserve this exact journal, paper tone, handwriting style, and the owner's kit of pens, tape, and photo-corners while showing different days and pasted ephemera.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names on any ticket or photo, no perfectly straight edges, no digital gradient, no HDR, no glossy varnish, no symmetry, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
title: Journal Foundation
description: The reference spread of a handmade Sunday journal, establishing paper tone, handwriting cadence, and the owner's kit of tape, pen, and photo corners.
